main.description: A request to join a members-only (space-backed) board. Lives in the requester's repo. A forum sysop resolves it by granting space membership (approve) or recording a moderation.action denyAccess (deny).

board.description: The app.atmobb.forum.board being requested. Its authority is the forum's DID.

reason.description: Optional note from the requester to the moderators.
